hook: Even proof checkers can be wrong too.

beats.say: Some computer programs claim to check every step of a proof, yet reported soundness bugs have let false statements slip past them.
Reports span the major checkers: three bugs listed for Mizar, seven for Metamath, and nine for Isabelle, the most in the list.
In many cases the bugs were demonstrated to be exploitable, a warning against trusting any machine verification completely blindly.
